comparison_groups.assignment: Preoperative patient education and home exercise

target.intended_analysis_population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups

measurement.method: Isokinetic knee extension peak torque measured at 60◦/s with a Biodex dynamometer; average of all three trials

time_point_or_window.description: Baseline (4 weeks before TKA), post-intervention (1 day before TKA after the 3-week program), and 6 weeks after TKA
